convert_fx_observed_model: convert an observed PyTorch FX GraphModule model to a reference quantized model with optional backend config and custom config
convert_custom_module_lstm: convert an observed custom LSTM module to a quantized custom module with quantized inputs and outputs
convert_standalone_module: convert an observed standalone GraphModule submodule to a quantized standalone module separately from parent
convert_weighted_module_linear: convert a weighted module like Linear or Conv2d to a reference quantized module with weight observers
replace_observer_with_decomposed_qdq: replace activation observer nodes with quantized_decomposed quantize and dequantize operator nodes in the FX graph
